title: Nasruddin and the Donkey's Shadow Sale
summary: When a greedy merchant claimed the right to charge travelers for resting in his donkey's shadow, Nasruddin offered to buy the shadow for five silver coins....
keywords: nasruddin and the donkey's shadow sale
full_text:
When a greedy merchant claimed the right to charge travelers for resting in his donkey's shadow, Nasruddin offered to buy the shadow for five silver coins.

The merchant took the money. Nasruddin then commanded the donkey to walk behind his own cottage: "The shadow is mine! I am taking it home, and your donkey must follow it wherever my shadow goes!" The merchant had to refund the money to get his donkey back.
moral: Charging for illusions leaves both buyer and seller in the desert.
